senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טפף I) [to join closely, whence טֶפַח (cmp. קוֹמֶץ) joined fingers, hand-breadth,] to come in close contact; (cmp. נָקַשׁ) to strike, knock.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:20">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>נתזה בקעת וטָפְחָה לו על פניו</he> Ms. M. a chip flew off and struck him in the face.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>נתזו … וטָפְחוּ לו וכ׳</he> Ms. M. sparks flew off and hit him &c.; a. fr.—Esp. (denom. of <cite ref="I00639"><he>טֶפַח</he></cite>) <cite ref="I00636"><he>טָפַח</he></cite>, a.

senses.gloss: to strike with the flat hand, to slap.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>, end <he>התחיל אדה״ר מְטַפֵּחַ על פניו</he> Adam slapped his own face; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <cite ref="I00199"><he>טוֹפֵחַ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:13">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>טָפְחָה לו על ראשו</he> slapped him on his head.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:6">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>טְפָחַתָּהּ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 79:6">Yalk. ib. 79</cite> <he>קפחתה</he>) she slapped her face with her shoe. Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ top <he>טי׳ כנגד וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:12">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>הכהו</he>) if he struck him over his eye and blinded him.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:10">Ab. Zar. IV, 10</cite> <he>היה מְטַפֵּחַ על וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. 60ᵇ <he>מַטְפִּיחַ</he>, Y. ed. <he>מתפח</he>) he slapped upon the fermenting barrel (to check fermentation).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 3:8">Toh. III, 8</cite> <he>שדרך התינוק לטַפֵּחַ</he> a child likes to slap (dough &c., to dabble); a. e.

senses.gloss: to clap hands to a certain tune in rejoicing or mourning, v. טִיפּוּחַ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:2">Bets. V, 2</cite> <he>לא מְטַפְּחִין וכ׳</he> we must not clap hands, or strike upon the knees, or stamp on the Holy Day.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:8">M. Kat. III, 8</cite> <he>מענות אבל לא מְטַפְּחוֹת</he> may sing the dirge but must not clap.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> … <he>שהיה מקיש וטוֹפַחַ</he> he knocked his hands against each other and clapped; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">ib.</cite> <he>וטפח</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>מְטַפַּחַת באגפיה</he> clapped her wings.

senses.gloss: to collect the contents of a broken vessel by palming, to wipe with the palm.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 143b:2">Sabb. 143ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא יְטַפֵּחַ בשמן</he> must not use the palm for collecting oil in the broken vessel.
